units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>עֲקִיצָתָן עֲקִיצַת עקרב</he> (Ar. <he>עֲקִיסָתָן עֲקִיסַת</he>) their sting (the scholars’ ban) is a scorpion’s sting; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:3:2">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵇ</cite> top <he>שכר ע׳</he> remuneration for cutting, contrad. to <cite ref="L00690"><he>לקיטה</he></cite>.
